title: Sitemaps for Localized Content and Razor Pages | Orchard Core
description:
Search engines need a sitemap that lists every page of a site, including each translation of a page and the pages that your own code displays. A sitemap lists the content types that its providers can route, and Autoroute provides the routes of the types that have an Autoroute part.

The Localized Content Item Sitemaps feature adds an alternate link with the hreflang attribute for every localization of a content item. The Sitemaps for Decoupled Razor Pages feature lists the content types that your own Razor Pages display, with SitemapsRazorPagesOptions in Program.cs.

In this video:
• How a sitemap finds its pages: providers of routeable content types
• Localized content item sitemaps: alternate language links for every item
• Sitemaps for Decoupled Razor Pages: routes for content that your own pages display
• Routing other content: write your own provider
